prompt: Original 45-second instrumental composition. Instruments exclusively: sitar, soft tabla and tanpura. 88 BPM. restrained spacious melodic phrases. A distinctive concise motif, moderate variation every eight bars, no long introduction, clean resolved ending. Designed as a restrained background for a narrated video. No human voices, speech, singing, humming, choir or vocal samples. Clear natural instrument timbres with no feedback or clipping.

description.en: A melodic and rhythmic piece featuring a prominent plucked string instrument, likely a sitar, accompanied by traditional Indian percussion. It evokes a meditative yet engaging atmosphere.
description.zh: 一段旋律优美且富有节奏感的音乐，以突出的拨弦乐器（可能是西塔琴）为主，并伴有印度传统打击乐器。它营造出一种冥想而引人入胜的氛围。
